---
title: "QoL unadjusted landmark — model fitting"
subtitle: "Computationally reduced analysis using primary imputations 1–5"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

This supporting analysis uses exactly the first five completed datasets from
the primary six-month QoL analysis. It fits an unadjusted Bayesian
proportional-odds model to the same death-inclusive endpoint. The outcome is
ordered from best QoL (1) through death (8), so a negative treatment
coefficient favours intervention. The treatment log-odds ratio uses the same
$N(0, 0.5)$ prior as the primary analysis.

```{r}
#| label: fit-supporting-qol-unadjusted-landmark
#| include: false

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
imputations <- readRDS(here::here(
  "artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life", "imputations.rds"
))
indices <- config$imputation$supporting$indices
model_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "qol-unadjusted-landmark", "models"
)
diagnostic_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "qol-unadjusted-landmark", "diagnostics"
)
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(diagnostic_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pcontrast_tx <- list(
  c1 = list(tx = 1),
  c2 = list(tx = 0),
  contrast = expression(c1 - c2),
  mu = 0,
  sd = 0.5
)

for (index in indices) {
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  diagnostic_path <- file.path(
    diagnostic_dir,
    sprintf("diagnostics-%02d.parquet", index)
  )
  if (!force && file.exists(model_path) && file.exists(diagnostic_path)) next

  data <- imputations[[index]] |>
    dplyr::mutate(y_landmark = ordered(y_landmark, levels = 1:8))
  dd <- rms::datadist(data)
  options(datadist = "dd")

  fit_seed <- analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index, offset = 400L)
  model <- rmsb::blrm(
    y_landmark ~ tx,
    pcontrast = pcontrast_tx,
    data = data,
    chains = config$markov$chains,
    iter = config$markov$iterations,
    warmup = config$markov$warmup,
    seed = fit_seed
  )
  draws <- posterior::as_draws_df(rmsb::stanGet(model))
  diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(draws) |>
    as.data.frame()
  finite_rhat <- diagnostics$rhat[is.finite(diagnostics$rhat)]
  finite_bulk <- diagnostics$ess_bulk[is.finite(diagnostics$ess_bulk)]
  finite_tail <- diagnostics$ess_tail[is.finite(diagnostics$ess_tail)]
  passed <- length(finite_rhat) > 0L && length(finite_bulk) > 0L &&
    length(finite_tail) > 0L &&
    all(finite_rhat <= config$diagnostics$max_rhat) &&
    all(finite_bulk >= config$diagnostics$min_ess_bulk) &&
    all(finite_tail >= config$diagnostics$min_ess_tail)

  if (!passed) {
    model <- rmsb::blrm(
      y_landmark ~ tx,
      pcontrast = pcontrast_tx,
      data = data,
      chains = config$markov$chains,
      iter = config$markov$retry_iterations,
      warmup = config$markov$retry_iterations / 2L,
      seed = fit_seed + 500000L
    )
    draws <- posterior::as_draws_df(rmsb::stanGet(model))
    diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(draws) |>
      as.data.frame()
    finite_rhat <- diagnostics$rhat[is.finite(diagnostics$rhat)]
    finite_bulk <- diagnostics$ess_bulk[is.finite(diagnostics$ess_bulk)]
    finite_tail <- diagnostics$ess_tail[is.finite(diagnostics$ess_tail)]
    passed <- length(finite_rhat) > 0L && length(finite_bulk) > 0L &&
      length(finite_tail) > 0L &&
      all(finite_rhat <= config$diagnostics$max_rhat) &&
      all(finite_bulk >= config$diagnostics$min_ess_bulk) &&
      all(finite_tail >= config$diagnostics$min_ess_tail)
  }
  if (!passed) {
    stop(
      "Persistent convergence failure in unadjusted landmark QoL imputation ",
      index,
      "."
    )
  }

  saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
  arrow::write_parquet(diagnostics, diagnostic_path, compression = "zstd")
}

options(datadist = NULL)
```
